# Roleplay Rule 4 - Do not powergame.
Powergaming is defined by collecting items that give you an advantage for no reason.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Trying to get medical supplies when wounded or going into dangerous situations. - Collecting items useful for your job. - Do whatever the hell you want as an antagonist.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Preparing for antagonists that pose you no threat. - Preparing for antagonists you dont know about - Preparing for situations you dont know will happen. - Preparing weapons / armor for no reason.
